cases.scope: Build and explicitly deliver the complete lightweight source BIM and its viewer from all supplied drawings, covering every floor. This run prioritizes completing the autonomous workflow: read the inputs, save a usable draft for each floor, compile and repair blocking errors, assemble the whole building, and explicitly finish delivery with finish_bim. Save each draft as soon as usable calibration and structure can be declared; use labelled provisional assumptions for unresolved details and retain their evidence limits. Preserve physical rooms, partitions, opening hosts and connectivity, with one shared origin and the current 0.1 m regularization policy. Geometry accuracy and independent quality scoring are deferred for this run; do not claim verified drawing fidelity. Work with the whole drawing set in this single context. A status report or a partial floor is not the requested delivery. There is no run-level time deadline.
